sorry it is "ip dhcp relay address 192.0.2.1" written correctly.
It is a interface VLAN, SVI feature, for IP broadcast to be relayed over a routed network to a DHCP servers unicast IP. Not a VLAN feature.
VLAN is a ethernet frame tag, Interface VLAN is a IP interface. This "ip dhcp relay address ...."  is configured in the the interface vlan, let's say "interface vlan100" f.e.
